title: Alton Purnell, Reason's cousin
summary: Allen mentions Purnell and Reason says he is his cousin, who came to the West Coast in 1954.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah. There's so many of those people like that you can't think of. Anyway... He died, didn't he? I don't know. Brickle Alexander? I don't know. I really don't know. I've forgotten. I... It's funny. You forget who's alive. I think he is. Alvin Prenial. Alvin Prenial. Did you know him? Yeah. I saw him a few weeks ago. That's my cousin.
Now, he said he was born in New Orleans. He was. He said 26 St. Peter's. Yeah. But, uh...

He had a brother's alto player. Yeah. He's... Ted... Wiggles. Wiggles, yeah. Yeah. Anyway, he was in town, and he was going to Pennsylvania with Barry Martin's band, the legend of jazz. Yeah. From out of California. Barry's an Englishman.
Well, uh... My... Druggist saw him on a plane. They was going to Pennsylvania.
He moved to the west coast after I did.
I went out there in 53 and he came out in 54. He first came out there with George Lewis Brown.
